rounds.title: Parent-child synchronization
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Use child selection as the source of truth for the tree.
constraints: The parent selects or clears every child in one transition.
All children selected means the parent is checked.
No children selected means the parent is unchecked.

rounds.title: Indeterminate derivation
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Represent partial selection without storing contradictory parent state.
constraints: Some but not all children selected puts the parent in an indeterminate state.
Derive checked and indeterminate from child IDs after every transition.
Expose partial selection as aria-checked mixed.

frameworkTests.name: Round 2 · One child creates mixed state

rounds.title: Stable selection contract
rounds.interviewerPrompt: Keep identity and status correct through alternating parent and child updates.
constraints: Track children by stable IDs rather than array positions.
Clearing one child after Select all leaves the other children selected.
Render a polite selected-count status after every update.
Repeated transitions must not duplicate selected IDs.

frameworkTests.name: Round 3 · Child update after Select all remains consistent
